task_name: World 474 Task A  -  Cross-Month Negative Expense Detection, Multi-Month Catch-Up Refusal & Cash-Basis Accrual Reversal
prompt: Review the Monthly_PL_And_Catchup_JEs schedule in `roast_bloom_cafes_oct2026_monthly_cleanliness_and_continuity.xlsx`. Identify any single-month negative expense column masked by a positive year-to-date total, evaluate multi-month catch-up lump entries lacking period-of-origin schedules, audit cash-basis branch payroll accruals, and state the pre-render PDF cleanliness gate outcome.

rubric.description: Flags September -$2,149.56 negative Taxes & Licenses column despite positive +$3,839.88 YTD total.
Refuses unallocated 9-month $18,450.00 payroll-tax catch-up lump in September ($2,050.00 monthly run-rate across $20,500.00 10-month total) without period-of-origin schedule.
Reverses the $1,957.71 October 31 payroll accrual on the pure cash-basis Downtown branch and blocks client PDF generation while monthly distortions remain.
